role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 127, printed p. 121: the second river of the mountain of Kirmān concluded; two more rivers from the same mountain, the second given in a later hand in the margin of the manuscript; a river from a spring; a river from a mountain without a name to the sea at the town امرس, with a river from the mountain ارٮٮطا that falls into it; and a river from the mountain اوٮدٮون, from which two rivers branch off to the sea. The editor's running numbers (١٨٢٥)-(١٨٤٠) and the numbers of Suhrāb [١٨٣٠]-[١٨٤٥]; the folio of the manuscript, «(fol. 36ᵃ)», at the beginning of the first line; words supplied by the editor between angle brackets. Six lines of the editor's footnotes.

lines.plain: والعرض ⟨كز ō⟩ (١٨٢٥) [١٨٣٠] ⟨ومصبّه⟩ فى البحر عند طول

lines.text: [١٨٣٥] * نهر اوّله عين عند طول {ov:ڡ ك}{n:g} والعرض {ov:كد ل} (١٨٣١) [١٨٣٦] ومصبّه
lines.plain: [١٨٣٥] * نهر اوّله عين عند طول ڡ ك والعرض كد ل (١٨٣١) [١٨٣٦] ومصبّه

lines.text: فى البحر عند طول {ov:صط مه} والعرض {ov:كا ى} (١٨٣٢) [١٨٣٧] * نهر من جبل اوّله عند

lines.plain: طول ڡح ل والعرض كه ō (١٨٣٣) [١٨٣٨] ومصبّه فى البحر عند مدينة امرس

lines.text: ثمّ يفترق منه نهران{n:k} يصبّان الى البحر مصبّ احدهما عند طول {ov:قو ل} والعرض {ov:ك {z}}
lines.plain: ثمّ يفترق منه نهران يصبّان الى البحر مصبّ احدهما عند طول قو ل والعرض ك ō
(١٨٣٩) [١٨٤٤] ومصبّ الآخر عند طول قو ō والعرض ٮر ō (١٨٤٠) [١٨٤٥] *

variants: L01: the leaves of the manuscript are bound out of order here: the text of fol. 34ᵇ goes on on fol. 36ᵃ; the editor refers to his introduction (note a).
L01: the manuscript has a gap at the latitude between the brackets; the editor supplies it after entries (647)-(648) and S (note b).
L01: the manuscript has a gap at the word between the brackets; the editor supplies it (note c).
L02: a variant reading of the longitude is صر ō, with a line over the numerals (note d).
L04, L05: the words between the two marks e, from the river «ونهر من هٰذا الجبل ايضاً» to «ومصبّه», stand in the margin of the manuscript in a later hand, and all of them are badly damaged (note e).
L05: the manuscript has a gap at the words between the brackets; the editor supplies them after S (note f).
L06: a variant reading of the longitude is ڡ ō, with a line over the numerals (note g).
L09: a variant reading of the latitude is كج ō, with a line over the numerals (note h).
L12: a variant reading of the latitude is كو ō, with a line over the numerals (note i).

L13: the manuscript first had ٮهريں, the first tooth and the final ن without their dots, which a later hand corrected (note k, which prints ٮهرين, with the dot of the final ن, corrected in the editor's corrigenda (p. 163, frame 169)).
unresolved: L10: the two teeth may be the teeth of a س with one tooth not printed: ارسطا. Transcribed ارٮٮطا.
L14: the notched form may also be read as a single ر whose head is split, ر, 7. Transcribed ٮر.
observations: The second river of the mountain of Kirmān goes on from p. 120 (frame 126), whose last words, «ونهر من هٰذا الجبل ايضاً ⟨اوّله عند طول صب {z}⟩», L01 continues with «والعرض ⟨كز {z}⟩ (١٨٢٥)», the latitude ⟨27° 0′⟩ of its beginning; «⟨ومصبّه⟩ فى البحر عند طول ص {z} والعرض كو ں (١٨٢٦) *» (L01-L02), ⟨and its mouth⟩ is in the sea at the longitude 90° 0′ and the latitude 26° 50′.

L01: the folio of the Strasbourg manuscript, «(fol. 36ᵃ)», is printed in Latin type at the beginning of the line, followed by the note mark a; transcribed as a margin note before the line, with the mark a at the beginning of the line, before «والعرض».

L02-L04: «نهر من جبل كرمان ايضاً اوّله عند طول صج {z} والعرض كه مه (١٨٢٧)», a river also from the mountain of Kirmān; its beginning is at the longitude 93° 0′ and the latitude 25° 45′; «ومصبّه فى البحر عند طول صا ى والعرض كه ل (١٨٢٨) *», and its mouth in the sea is at the longitude 91° 10′ and the latitude 25° 30′. The mountain of Kirmān is entries 647-648 of the table of the mountains (frame 050, L13), the entries after which the editor supplies the latitude of L01 (note b).

L04-L06: «ونهر من هٰذا الجبل ايضاً اوّله عند طول صح ك والعرض كه {z} (١٨٢٩)», and a river also from this mountain; its beginning is at the longitude 98° 20′ and the latitude 25° 0′; «ومصبّه ⟨فى البحر عند طول صا ن والعرض⟩ كد م (١٨٣٠) *», and its mouth is ⟨in the sea at the longitude 91° 50′ and the⟩ latitude 24° 40′. The note mark e stands after the latitude «كه ل» (L04) and again after «ومصبّه» (L05): the editor's note e, printed «e—e», refers to the passage between the two marks.

L06-L07: «نهر اوّله عين عند طول ڡ ك والعرض كد ل (١٨٣١)», a river whose beginning is a spring at the longitude ڡ ك and the latitude 24° 30′; «ومصبّه فى البحر عند طول صط مه والعرض كا ى (١٨٣٢) *», and its mouth in the sea is at the longitude 99° 45′ and the latitude 21° 10′.

L07-L09: «نهر من جبل اوّله عند طول ڡح ل والعرض كه {z} (١٨٣٣)», a river from a mountain whose name is not given; its beginning is at the longitude ڡح ل and the latitude 25° 0′; «ومصبّه فى البحر عند مدينة امرس عند طول ڡح {z} والعرض ك {z} (١٨٣٤)», and its mouth is in the sea at the town امرس, at the longitude ڡح ō and the latitude 20° 0′. The town is entry 115 of the table of the cities (frame 017, L01), «امرس على البحر», at the longitude قح ل and the latitude ك ō, where the editor's note a says that entry (1834) writes the name امرس.

L09-L11: «يقع الى هٰذا النهر نهر من جبل ارٮٮطا اوّله عند طول ڡو {z} والعرض كد ل (١٨٣٥)», into this river falls a river from the mountain ارٮٮطا; its beginning is at the longitude ڡو ō and the latitude 24° 30′; «ومصبّه فى النهر عند طول ڡج ل والعرض ك م (١٨٣٦) *», and its mouth in the river is at the longitude ڡج ل and the latitude 20° 40′. The mountain is entries 713-714 of the table of the mountains (frame 054, L14), printed in the same form.

L10: «ارٮٮطا»: after «ار», two teeth without dots, the first 14 px and the second 10 px high, then the ط and the final alif, where a medial س of this type has three low teeth before the ط (frame 054, L08, «اسطوس»). Transcribed with two teeth without dots, as the table (frame 054, L14).

L11-L14: «نهر من جبل اوٮدٮون اوّله عند طول ڡكا ل والعرض كر {z} (١٨٣٧)», a river from the mountain اوٮدٮون; its beginning is at the longitude ڡكا ل and the latitude كر ō; «يمرّ الى طول ڡح {z} والعرض ٮط ل (١٨٣٨)», it passes to the longitude ڡح ō and the latitude ٮط ل; «ثمّ يفترق منه نهران يصبّان الى البحر مصبّ احدهما عند طول قو ل والعرض ك {z} (١٨٣٩) ومصبّ الآخر عند طول قو {z} والعرض ٮر {z} (١٨٤٠) *», then two rivers branch off from it and flow into the sea; the mouth of the one is at the longitude 106° 30′ and the latitude 20° 0′, and the mouth of the other at the longitude 106° 0′ and the latitude ٮر ō. The mountain is entries 717-718 of the table of the mountains (frame 054, L16), «جبل اوٮدٮون»; here, too, «اوٮدٮون»: after «او», a tooth without a dot, 17 px high, joined to a د, then a tooth without a dot joined to a و, and the final ن with its dot.

Numerals: «⟨كز {z}⟩» (L01), with the dot of the ز, 27° 0′; «ص {z}» (L02), 90° 0′; «كو ں» (L02), the و a round loop, and the minutes the bowl of a final ن without its dot, 26° 50′; «صج {z}» (L03), with the dot of the ج, 93° 0′; «كه مه» (L03), 25° 45′; «صا ى» (L03), 91° 10′; «كه ل» (L04), 25° 30′; «صح ك» (L04), 98° 20′; «كه {z}» (L05, L08), 25° 0′; «⟨صا ن⟩» (L05), with the dot of the ن, 91° 50′; «كد م» (L05), 24° 40′; «كد ل» (L06, L10), 24° 30′; «صط مه» (L07), 99° 45′; «كا ى» (L07), 21° 10′; «ك {z}» (L09, L13), 20° 0′; «ك م» (L11), 20° 40′; «قو ل» (L13), with the two dots of the ق, 106° 30′; «قو {z}» (L14), 106° 0′.

Without their dots, transcribed so: the loop of ف or ق without dots in the degrees of the longitude, read with ق: «ڡ» (L06), the isolated letter with its flat tail, 100; «ڡح» (L08, L09, L12), 108; «ڡو» (L10), 106; «ڡج» (L11), with the dot of the ج, 10 by 9 px, in the bowl, 103; «ڡكا» (L11), 121; where L13 and L14 print «قو» with the two dots of the ق. L08: in the bowl of «ڡح» stands a speck of 4 by 4 px, where the dot of the ج of «ڡج» (L11) is 10 by 9 px; transcribed ح. «كر» (L12), the letter joined to the end of the ك with the small pointed head of the ر, where the editor's note i prints «كو» with the round loop of the و; in these numerals the editor reads ر as ز, 7 (introduction, frame 196, p. XVII), so 27. «ٮط» (L12), a tooth without its dot joined to a ط, which read with a ي gives 19. «ٮر» (L14), the notched form of frame 041 (L06), a short tooth without a dot joined to a ر, the two forming a notch at the top, which read as يز gives 17.

The ح of the numerals, «صح» (L04) and «ڡح» (L08, L09, L12), shows no dot in the bowl. The isolated ك, 20, is printed with the small inner stroke of the letter (L04, L06, L09, L11, L13); the isolated ى, 10, has no dots (L03, L07).

Angle brackets, each followed by a note mark, around what the editor supplies: «⟨كز {z}⟩» (L01), the latitude, within the line over the numerals, note b; «⟨ومصبّه⟩» (L01), note c; «⟨فى البحر عند طول صا ن والعرض⟩» (L05), note f. Transcribed with the brackets.

Signs in the text, transcribed as printed: «اوّله» (L02, L04, L06, L07, L10, L11) with a shadda over the و; «ومصبّه» (L01, L03, L05, L06, L08, L10), «يصبّان» and «مصبّ» (L13) and «ومصبّ» (L14) with a shadda over the ب; «يمرّ» (L12) and «ثمّ» (L13) with a shadda; «هٰذا» (L04, L09) with a dagger alif above the ه; «ايضاً» (L02, L04) with the tanwin of the accusative over its alif; «الآخر» (L14) with a madda over the alif; «فى» and «الى» end in a ى without dots.

The running numbers run (١٨٢٥)-(١٨٤٠) without a gap, and the numbers of Suhrāb [١٨٣٠]-[١٨٤٥] stand after each of them, without a gap. [١٨٣٥] stands at the beginning of L06, after the running number (١٨٣٠) at the end of L05, and (١٨٣٩) [١٨٤٤] at the beginning of L14, after the latitude at the end of L13.
Asterisks: the small open stars with six points, after [١٨٣١] (L02), [١٨٣٣] (L04), [١٨٣٥] (L06), [١٨٣٧] (L07), [١٨٤١] (L11) and [١٨٤٥] (L14), are transcribed as asterisks.

Note marks: L01, a after the folio, b after the closing bracket of the latitude and c after the closing bracket of «⟨ومصبّه⟩»; L02, d after the longitude; L04, e after the latitude; L05, e after «ومصبّه» and f after the closing bracket; L06, g after the longitude; L09, h after the latitude; L12, i after the latitude; L13, k after «نهران».

Marks not transcribed: L03, a dot of 7 by 8 px below the ك of «كه مه», smaller than the dots of the font; L05, two specks of 4 by 4 px above the و of «والعرض» within the brackets; L13, a dot of 7 by 6 px on the line after the zero of the latitude, at the end of the line.
The editor's footnotes stand in six lines below a short rule at the left: notes a-k. The page number «— ١٢١ —» stands at the foot, centred.
